headline.text: L1 THG faulted out *three times* with no root cause identified; L3 truffle M4 belt needs two operators to hand-feed until Saturday repair

per_plant_summary.L1: Ran caramel cluster all day with three separate THG faults—two restarts (7 and 10 minutes each) plus a belt tracking issue that cleared after CILT. Maintenance has no root cause yet. Weights dipped below spec at 08:13, recovered by 10:54.
per_plant_summary.L2: Two temper unit faults: overnight reheat took 2 hours (back up 04:10), midday fault cleared in 7 minutes. FFS paused 23 minutes for checkweigher calibration. All lines running at window close.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 trial hit sensor issues on wrap—team manually wrapped ~50K pieces. Truffle line M4 drive roller slipping; two operators hand-aligning product to reduce rejects until Saturday repair. ML1 rice hopper faulted twice, cleared both times. MFM printer fault created 2 pallets without dates (on hold for rework).

resolved.title: S4 THG startup failure—first occurrence
resolved.summary: THG refused to start at 09:36, line stopped while maintenance investigated root cause
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:43—"THG is back up and running we will start the line back up" (Nathan Topham). Down 7 minutes.

resolved.title: S4 THG HMI screen went blank—second occurrence
resolved.summary: THG unresponsive at 11:32 with blank HMI screen, different issue than first fault; maintenance performed hard reset
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:42—"Line is starting back up the hard reset did fix this issue" (Nathan Topham). Down 10 minutes. Safety switches on swinging doors were generating faults; maintenance realigned switches and performed master reset.

resolved.title: S4 weights below acceptable limits
resolved.summary: Piece weights dropped below spec at 08:13; team adjusted and weights recovered to acceptable range by 10:54
resolved.resolution: Team addressed issue starting 08:23; weights confirmed in range by 10:54 per Nathan Topham

resolved.title: S4 THG belt pausing without alarm
resolved.summary: First section of THG belts pausing intermittently with no alarm on HMI at 15:32; 30-minute pause scheduled for CILT and troubleshooting
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 16:41—Erandy retracted belt into auto track during CILT, sensors back on; Conner reported no fault for ~10 minutes after restart

resolved.title: ML2 temper unit low mass temperature fault—overnight
resolved.summary: Temper unit faulted at 02:16 on low mass temperature with buffer at 63% and no obvious cause; maintenance troubleshooting
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:10—reheat completed, temper in range, depositing resumed. One heater was cooler to touch (likely tripped). Down approximately 2 hours.

resolved.title: ML2 temper unit pressure fault—midday
resolved.summary: Temper unit faulted at 12:36 on pressure; scraper stopped working; reheat initiated
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:43—"Did a reheat until mass cooling hit 35C. Scraper is back working and we are tempering again" (Alex Mendoza). Down 7 minutes. Pump compensator turned off, buffer set to 48°C.

resolved.title: FFS checkweigher accuracy concern
resolved.summary: Alan Todd requested Troy Baxter verify checkweigher accuracy during production at 07:40
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:33—Troy performed span calibration and slowed belt from 75m/min to 65m/min; variance now 1-1.5g, running well

resolved.title: ML1 rice hopper stopped—first occurrence
resolved.summary: Rice hopper stopped working at 07:16; maintenance notified
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:37—operators with Shawn's help disconnected and reconnected sensor; running again. Maintenance to inspect sensor post-production to determine root cause.

resolved.title: MFM printer faulted, 2 pallets without date codes
resolved.summary: Printer faulted at 07:18 on MFM, creating 2 pallets with no date printed on pouches; maintenance en route
resolved.resolution: Printer working again by 08:04; 2 pallets placed on hold for rework after order completion per Frederick Peairs

resolved.title: ML1 rice hopper stopped—second occurrence
resolved.summary: Rice hopper stopped working again at 07:53; maintenance notified
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:19—Shawn adjusted weight-sensing piece on hopper valve that was positioned too far back; monitoring to confirm fix holds

resolved.title: ML1 depositor nozzle clog
resolved.summary: Line paused at 00:48 due to clogged nozzle on depositor; operator working to clear
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:57—"Nozzle unclog, started running back up" (Raoul Lubain). Down approximately 1 hour.

needs_attention.title: S4 THG root cause unknown after three faults
needs_attention.summary: THG faulted three separate times (09:36, 11:32, 15:32) with different symptoms each time; maintenance cleared each fault but has no root cause identified
needs_attention.status: All three faults cleared and line running at window close, but Nathan reported at 11:56 that "Maintenance doesn't know a root cause to either of the issues that happened today."

needs_attention.title: S3 Cross Conveyor 2 bent knob and loose wheels
needs_attention.summary: During cleaning at 16:29, EEs noticed one knob severely bent and two wheels very loose on Cross Conveyor 2
needs_attention.status: Caleb York and William Lopez asked for details on what happened to prevent recurrence; no repair status provided by window close

needs_attention.title: MFM 3 pallets with incorrect (past) date on labels
needs_attention.summary: At 08:43 shift check found 3 pallets with past date on labels despite correct date verified at shift start
needs_attention.status: 3 pallets identified with past date; no follow-up on hold status or corrective action by window close

needs_attention.title: MFM C6 conveyor sensor moved, caused flavor mixing
needs_attention.summary: Sensor on C6 conveyor Z moved out of position at 09:29, failed to detect product, causing backup and flavor mixing at the top
needs_attention.status: Sensor issue reported at 09:29; no follow-up on resolution or corrective action by window close

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line M4 belt drive roller slipping
needs_attention.summary: M4 drive roller slipping causes chicane misalignment and sensor rejects; two employees manually aligning product to reduce waste
needs_attention.status: Workaround in place with manual alignment as of 13:27. Jason Jensen noted slides not greased properly and drive roller slipping; repair scheduled for Saturday cleaning downtime per Grey Boscan at 13:27.
